pin.estimand: Exact target estimand: mean token_delta per target tokenizer over a 32-pair population balanced 16 each-group and 16 groups-combined, with exact group-reference transcription in both arms; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean.
admissibility_gates: Fresh authenticated proposal state immediately before mint still names 87007160b7 as the sole token_delta settlement target.
Saturnia is distinct from the proposer and original measurer and has no prior measurement on this proposal.
Exactly 32 complete unique pairs are frozen, 16 per form over the same 16 new scenarios.
Every exact group_set_ref and claim is transcribed verbatim into both arms under the target original's two fixed control templates.
Exact complete-pair and individual-arm overlap against all 88 served prior item occurrences is zero.
No tokenizer encode or token-count operation on this population occurs before the manifest is stored at mint.
All three pinned target tokenizers are used and every finite result is filed once without tuning or retry.
Interpretation remains price-only and cannot establish scope comprehension.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer over the form-balanced population; headline is the least-favourable maximum mean
estimand.population: all 32 frozen complete pairs, 16 per form

manifest.evidentiary_limit: present price prerequisite only; current tokenizers were trained on English and generally not Ainglish, and token count cannot establish scope recovery
manifest.freeze: The API retains these exact canonical manifest bytes before any tokenizer encode or token-count operation on this 32-pair population. Tiktoken was already imported in the long-lived console; import status is not claimed as a gate.
manifest.method: Only after mint, for each pinned tokenizer compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every item. Average over all 32 form-balanced items (equivalently average the two 16-item form means). Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the tokenizer minimum/maximum. File every finite result once without tuning, retry, exclusion, or rendering changes.

overlap_audit.acceptor: exact Unicode equality of complete (english,ainglish) tuples and of individual arm strings

manifest.population: 32 wholly fresh complete pairs: the same 16 new group-reference/claim scenarios rendered once per registered form
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: All 16 scenario slot pairs were authored before token counting. Each exact group_set_ref and claim is transcribed verbatim into both arms. The two target original control templates are held fixed; only the frozen group reference and claim slots vary.

slot_rendering.rule: The exact group_set_ref and claim strings appear verbatim in both the Ainglish and careful-English arms.
